title: Looking for playtesters: a fantasy life sim where you can be a pot washer or a king, in a world that lives without you (Windows)
author: MotherVehkingMuatra
selftext:
Hi everyone. As you can see in my trailer, my fantasy life sim ‘Life in Lumbaris’ is ready for playtesters and I’d love it if you would be a part of it.

The game takes place in an original world packed full of lore, 5,000 locations to visit, different career and life paths, and countless ways to play. You could spend the game living life as a pot washer, eventually becoming the tavern manager and getting married to a sweetheart, or rise from the bottom to become a great ruler of your own territory.

NPCs live their own lives and can mostly do what the player can. You may find someone has decided to study magic, migrate to a new town, marry one of the story characters and more. A king could lie about being the chosen of a specific God and his underlings might urge him to declare war based on that, or the Goddess of Luck could bless some nobody NPC, simply because he gambled a lot. The idea is that the world doesn’t revolve around the player. You’re just another person living in it.

As for development, I’ve been building Lumbaris with the help of Claude, which has done a lot of the programming and implementation. I’ve focused on designing the world, its characters, systems and how everything should interact. The artwork is generated procedurally using a Python/Pillow pipeline that assembles assets based on character appearances, including portraits that reflect things like clothing and ageing. The hardest part has been scale: with around 12,000 people each living their own day, the simulation was taking about 40 seconds per in-game day, so we moved its core into C++ running across multiple threads, which got it down to around 2 seconds. The other big lesson was that AI drifts unless you pin it down, so I keep written rules for how characters should sound and a checker that flags AI habits like characters constantly sighing or smirking.

Most of the character arcs and stories were written by myself, but to fill out options for all the different player personalities (I’m really big on personal roleplay) I had Claude fill them out, with heavy oversight and rewrites from me.

I’m at the stage now where I really need people other than myself playing it. I’d particularly love feedback on how the world feels to live in, whether the different careers and life paths are enjoyable, and whether there’s anything that feels confusing or frustrating. I’m also interested in hearing about any unexpected things that happen in your playthroughs, because those are some of my favourite parts of the game.

The playtest is completely free, and there’s no obligation to provide feedback. If you would like to, comment here, DM me or send me a message on Discord (which you can find in the game folder). Please expect some rough edges and bugs!

Before you download: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), about 440 MB. Unzip the folder first, then run Life in Lumbaris.exe. If Windows says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info → Run anyway (the game isn’t code-signed yet).

[Playtest download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dvs1XpY9ao0GRbG8qhcxV7mTj0z67OYz/view?usp=sharing)

Thanks to anyone who gives it a go. I’ve put a lot into making this world and I’m really excited to finally have other people experience it.
